method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: HPE surges 29% as AI infrastructure boom boosts server demand
Equities.reason: Large, company-level earnings beat showing direct AI-driven revenue upside for servers and cloud hardware. Signals stronger earnings backdrop for AI-related tech names and reinforces the market’s AI leadership narrative — bullish for equities, particularly tech/semis.

Equities.title: Alphabet plans to raise $80 billion from stock sales to fund AI buildout
Equities.summary: Alphabet said it plans to sell $80 billion in stock, including through a $10 billion investment by Berkshire Hathaway.
Equities.reason: Massive equity issuance is market-significant — could create supply/dilution pressure and weigh on sentiment even as proceeds fund AI expansion. Mixed for the AI narrative but modestly negative for near-term equity flows.

Equities.title: Anthropic files for blockbuster initial public offering
Equities.summary: Move sets up race with OpenAI and SpaceX, testing Wall Street’s appetite for the AI boom
Equities.reason: A major AI IPO filing signals continued investor appetite and liquidity for AI assets, reinforcing the dominant AI-led risk-on equity regime and expectations for more tech capital market activity.

Equities.title: Nvidia jumps into PCs with new Arm-based chip debuting in laptops from Microsoft, Dell, HP
Equities.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang unveiled a long-awaited Arm-based PC chip, breaking into PCs for the first time on new laptops by Dell, Microsoft, HP, ASUS and others.
Equities.reason: Product expansion by a market-leading AI/semiconductor name strengthens the growth and leadership narrative in technology — supportive for broader equity sentiment and the AI trade.

Equities.title: S&P 500 Futures Dip With No Iran Deal, Oil Steady: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Geopolitical headlines (no Iran deal) are driving risk-off moves in futures and keeping volatility elevated — a clear near-term negative for equities and risk appetite.

Equities.title: Wall St ends higher, boosted by tech gains, US-Iran peace hopes
Equities.reason: Despite geopolitical jitters, tech-driven gains and AI optimism are still pushing major US indices to records — underscores the prevailing regime where AI leadership often offsets macro/geopolitical shocks.

Equities.title: S&P 500: Seen at 8000 by year-end 2026 – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank’s equity strategists remain constructive on US equities, projecting the S&P 500 at 8000 by year-end 2026. Recent price action shows the S&P 500 and NASDAQ extending record runs, supported by AI optimism and semiconductor strength, even as
Equities.reason: Bank strategist price target is explicitly bullish and reinforces the AI/semiconductor-led bull case, but it is a price forecast so assigned lower relevance under the framework.

Equities.title: The stock market just did something eerily similar to the dot-com bubble top in 2000
Equities.summary: Surging stock performance in May was concentrated in the AI adjacent.
Equities.reason: Analogy to dot-com concentration highlights market concentration and bubble risk in AI-adjacent names — a cautionary signal that lowers the structural conviction on an unqualified rally.

Equities.title: Asia stocks recover as AI optimism offsets Middle East anxiety
Equities.reason: Regional markets showing resilience as AI optimism offsets geopolitical anxiety — supports the cross-market narrative that AI-led flows continue to dominate risk sentiment across regions.

Rates.title: Pimco Says Treasury Yields Driven by Fed Bets, Not AI, for Now
Rates.reason: Pimco framing Treasury moves as driven by Fed expectations highlights a rates-driven narrative (higher-for-longer or repriced hikes) — negative for bond prices / yields up. High relevance as it speaks to the dominant driver of US yields.

Rates.title: New Iran Clashes Send Oil Prices and Bond Yields Surging
Rates.reason: Geopolitical escalation lifting oil and risk premia has pushed bond yields materially higher — a significant negative shock for global bonds and cash rates expectations.

Rates.title: PBOC Cuts Cash Operation to Record Low as Bond Rally Deepens
Rates.reason: Article signals an ongoing bond rally (yields falling) and PBOC reducing short-term cash injections — supportive for bond prices and lower yields in China, with spillovers to global rates.

Rates.title: Japan 10-Year Bond Sale Sees Firmer Demand Than 12-Month Average
Rates.reason: Stronger demand at a JGB auction implies continued buyer support and mildly lower JGB yields — a positive for bond markets (lower yields).

Rates.title: BOJ may heed calls to pause bond taper next year
Rates.reason: Discussion of a potential pause in BOJ tapering is supportive to bond markets (easing tapering path -> lower yields), relevant for JGB and global rate expectations.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meeting on April 20 and 29, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meeting on April 20 and 29, 2026
Rates.reason: Official minutes related to discount rate deliberations can reinforce a higher-for-longer Fed narrative or reluctance to cut — modestly negative for bond prices if they underscore tighter policy bias.

Rates.title: Meeting of 29-30 April 2026
Rates.reason: ECB meeting accounts can indicate policy stance and potential persistence of tighter conditions in Europe; treated as a modest tilt toward higher yields if the tone remains cautious.

Rates.title: Financial stability vulnerabilities remain elevated as geoeconomic shock unfolds
Rates.reason: ECB warning of elevated financial stability vulnerabilities amid geoeconomic shocks implies higher risk premia and potential upward pressure on yields — negative for bonds.

Rates.title: Polish Zloty: NBP on extended hold with mixed inflation – Commerzbank
Rates.summary: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose expects Poland’s National Bank of Poland (NBP) to keep its base rate unchanged for an extended period, with forward markets already pricing out medium-term cuts after the Iran-related energy shock.
Rates.reason: NBP staying on hold and forwards pricing out cuts (after energy shock) implies less easing than expected — modestly negative for Polish bond prices (yields relatively higher than prior expectations).

Rates.title: Fed's Powell warns Trump's political 'stress test' will wreck public trust in central bank
Rates.summary: Jerome Powell said White House pressure on the Fed will damage public trust in the U.S. central bank.
Rates.reason: Concerns about political pressure on Fed independence can raise policy uncertainty and risk premia, a low-to-moderate negative signal for bond markets and yields.

FX.title: Euro: Softer against US Dollar as yields climb – Danske Bank
FX.summary: Danske Research Team reports that EUR/USD declined as higher Oil prices lifted US and European yields. They note that 2-year EUR and USD swap rates rose by up to 6 basis points.
FX.reason: EUR/USD lost ground as higher oil pushed US and European yields up — a classic USD-support/yield-driven move. Clear USD-favouring macro transmission (yields/oil) makes this a direct USD-strength signal with above-minimal relevance.

FX.title: Euro gains traction above 1.1600 ahead of Eurozone HICP inflation release
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair holds positive ground near 1.1635 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. Hawkish stance of the European Central Bank (ECB) provides some support to the Euro (EUR) against the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: EUR showing strength ahead of HICP and supported by a hawkish ECB narrative — a direct EURUSD-support signal. Important near-term driver for EUR vs USD around key data, hence moderate relevance.

FX.title: US Dollar: Firm rangebound profile and oil link – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC's strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong keep a neutral stance on the US Dollar (USD), expecting a firm but rangebound USD profile as resilient US growth and sticky inflation support the currency.
FX.reason: Explicit sell-side call that resilient US growth and sticky inflation underpin a firm USD. This is a central USD narrative (sticky inflation → higher-for-longer rates) and therefore a material USD-support signal for FX positioning.

FX.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Approaches almost two-year high near 160.70
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair trades marginally higher to near 159.73 during the early European trading session on Tuesday. The pair edges up as the Japanese Yen (JPY) underperforms due to growing concerns regarding whether the Bank of Japan (BoJ) will raise interest rates
FX.reason: USD/JPY pushing toward multi-year highs signals USD strength / JPY weakness driven by BoJ uncertainty. JPY moves are a major FX regime driver (risk of intervention, carry/yield effects), so this is a meaningful USD-support/JPY-negative piece.

FX.title: BoJ discusses various options about bond buying or tapering with investors
FX.summary: There seems to be no immediate impact of the release of the BoJ summary of the meeting with investors on the Japanese Yen (JPY). As of writing, USD/JPY trades flat at around 159.70.
FX.reason: BoJ discussing bond-buying/tapering is a central-bank signal that could eventually strengthen JPY if action occurs. Immediate market reaction is muted, so relevance is limited now, but the policy discussion is FX-important longer term.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Stays weak against dollar, losses capped below 159.95 – UOB
FX.summary: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann notes USD/JPY climbed to 159.76 on Monday, closing at 159.65 with firmer upward momentum. Intraday, they see room for further gains but doubt a clear break above 159.95, with support at 159.55 and 159.40.
FX.reason: Bank technical/flow view confirming USD/JPY upward momentum — reinforces the dominant JPY-weakness / USD-strength narrative. Market-impactful for JPY positioning; relevance set above low-signal technical notes.

FX.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: British Pound breaks above 215.00, nearing intervention levels
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) keeps marching higher against an ailing Japanese Yen (JPY) on Tuesday.
FX.reason: GBP/JPY approaching intervention levels signals a material risk of FX policy action and underlines pronounced JPY weakness. Intervention risk is a major FX regime event, so relevance is high and the directional impact (JPY-negative / non-USD currency strength vs JPY) is given substantial weight.

FX.title: US Dollar Index: Trades with caution near 99.00 ahead of US JOLTS Job Openings data
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) trades subduedly in the European trading session on Tuesday ahead of the United States (US) JOLTS Job Openings data for April, which will be published at 14:00 GMT.
FX.reason: USD trading cautiously ahead of US labour-market data points to short-term USD fragility / data sensitivity. It's a near-term USD sentiment signal (data-dependent) rather than a structural shift, so relevance is limited-moderate.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Rises above nine-day EMA toward 0.7200
FX.summary: AUD/USD pares its latest losses from the previous day, trading around 0.7180 during the Asian hours on Tuesday.
FX.reason: AUD/USD technical/price-forecast shows AUD recovering vs USD. Price-forecast pieces carry capped relevance; included because commodity/China flow sensitivity remains a recurring FX theme.

FX.title: China’s Yuan Rises to Highest Level Against Basket Since 2022
FX.reason: RMB strengthening to multi-year highs against its policy basket is a significant EMFX development with implications for USD and regional FX flows. This is a material currency/regime signal (policy/flow-driven), so relevance is elevated.

FX.title: International role of the euro increased moderately in 2025
FX.reason: ECB data showing a stronger international role for the euro is a structural/central-bank-level signal that supports longer-term EUR demand vs USD. This is more than a data footnote — it informs regime/structural currency narratives, so relevance is moderate-high.

Commodities.title: Gold replaces US Treasuries as world’s top reserve asset, ECB says
Commodities.summary: Historic bullion rally boosts metal’s share of reserves to 27% while central banks diversify away from dollar
Commodities.reason: Central-bank reserve reweighting into gold is a major structural demand driver for the metal — high-impact, market-regime signal supporting higher gold prices and relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold: Forecasts revised lower on yields – OCBC
Commodities.summary: OCBC's strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong turn more cautious on Gold in the near term, cutting its price forecasts as elevated Oil prices, higher yields and a more hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) have weakened Gold’s backdrop.
Commodities.reason: Near-term bearish macro signal: higher yields and hawkish Fed pressure gold — relevant but a normal short-term forecast adjustment.

Commodities.title: Gold sticks to gains as Israel–Hezbollah ceasefire counters hawkish Fed and weighs on USD
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its bid tone through the first half of the European session on Tuesday and currently trades around the $4,530 area, just below the overnight swing high.
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical ceasefire reduces USD and risk premium pressures, supporting gold — event-driven bullish with moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold Holds Fall as Traders Digest Confusion Over US-Iran Talks
Commodities.reason: Headline suggests short-term downside amid geopolitical/Talks-driven volatility — useful as a market-flow counter-signal to bullish themes, but limited context in summary.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD hits highs near $77 amid a moderate risk appetite
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) appreciates on Tuesday, retracing losses from the previous two trading days and reaching session highs near $77.00. News of a ceasefire in Lebanon has lifted market sentiment, although it remains fragile amid conflicting messages from Iran’s c
Commodities.reason: Silver rally linked to precious-metals bid and risk/geo headlines — relevant to the metals complex, price-forecast tone (keeps relevance moderate).

Commodities.title: Brent Oil: Dual-path outlook and Hormuz risks – Deutsche Bank
Commodities.summary: Deutsche Bank’s Jim Reid and colleagues outline a baseline scenario in which a US-Iran agreement this month reopens the Strait of Hormuz, allowing Brent Oil to retreat toward $86 per barrel in Q4 2026.
Commodities.reason: Dual-path note: baseline (reopening → lower) is a meaningful medium-term bearish scenario, but near-term Hormuz risks keep prices supported — mixed but net modestly positive risk premium.

Commodities.title: Commodities in ‘Super-Squeeze’ as Hormuz Risks Build, HSBC Says
Commodities.reason: HSBC flags a broad commodity squeeze driven by Strait of Hormuz disruption risk — large cross-commodity supply-risk narrative that materially supports oil and related markets.

Commodities.title: Natural gas for power generation flat this summer, record high expected in 2027
Commodities.summary: We forecast natural gas consumption by the U.S. electric power sector this summer will remain near recent highs and set a record next summer in our May Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO). Despite a 2% increase in overall U.S. electricity demand this summer, we e
Commodities.reason: Rising electricity-sector gas demand (record next summer) is a clear bullish fundamental for US natural gas prices — medium-term demand-driven relevance.

Commodities.title: Most planned natural gas pipeline capacity additions in 2026 and 2027 originate in Texas
Commodities.summary: Developers plan to bring approximately 44.9 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) of new pipeline capacity online in the United States in 2026 and 2027, according to our latest Natural Gas Pipeline Projects Tracker. Approximately 70% (31.6 Bcf/d) of this new capa
Commodities.reason: Significant planned pipeline capacity increases are a supply-side easing factor for US natural gas — relevant to medium-term price pressure, lowering upside.

Commodities.title: The United States is a major energy exporter and importer, especially for petroleum
Commodities.summary: Total energy exports from the United States reached a record 31 quadrillion British thermal units (quads) in 2025, 2% more than the previous record set in 2024. U.S. energy imports were 21 quads, down 5% from 2024. Taken together, net trade—total imports less
Commodities.reason: Record US energy exports point to strong global supply/demand flows for petroleum and gas — supportive for energy prices but more of a structural/contextual datapoint (moderate relevance).

Commodities.title: Australian Wheat Crop Expected to Drop 26% on Weather, War Costs
Commodities.reason: Large Australian crop cut is a material supply shock for wheat — strong bullish fundamental for the global wheat market with high relevance.

Commodities.title: RBI May Have Sold Gold to Save FX Reserves, BE Analysis Shows
Commodities.reason: Potential central-bank gold sales (RBI) are a direct, albeit localized, supply-side bearish signal for gold — relevant but limited in scope and confirmation.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's biggest ETF selloff yet hits $3.4 billion as AI stocks keep climbing
Crypto.reason: Very large ETF outflows (~$3.4bn) represent substantial institutional liquidation pressure on BTC; major negative for crypto liquidity and price dynamics, elevating downside risk across the market.

Crypto.title: Crypto funds suffer second-largest outflows of 2026 while XRP and HYPE attract inflows
Crypto.reason: Broad crypto fund outflows (second-largest YTD) reinforce the institutional withdrawal narrative; repeated fund-level redemptions increase selling pressure and reduce tail liquidity.

Crypto.title: Mt. Gox moves 10,422 bitcoin worth $739 million to a new wallet as deadline nears
Crypto.reason: Large on-chain movement from Mt. Gox (~10,422 BTC) ahead of a deadline raises the prospect of concentrated selling or distribution into markets, a meaningful negative for BTC supply-side risk.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin drops below $70,000 as stocks pause and Strategy's BTC sale weighs on crypto
Crypto.reason: Market-price confirmation of the selling narrative: BTC breach of the $70k level amid equity weakness and reported sales signals a near-term risk-off for crypto and validates flow-driven downside.

Crypto.title: Michael Saylor's Strategy sold 32 bitcoin for $2.5 million to fund dividend payments
Crypto.reason: Idiosyncratic institutional sale by Strategy (32 BTC) is small in absolute size but contributed to market noise/panic; limited fundamental impact but relevant to short-term order flow.

Crypto.title: Crypto investment firm Keyrock is acquiring bankrupt lender Blockfills
Crypto.reason: Acquisition of a bankrupt crypto lender by an active market-maker/firm is constructive for market structure and counterparty risk, modestly positive for confidence and liquidity restoration.

Crypto.title: Bitmine slows ether purchase pace, buying $53 million worth last week
Crypto.reason: Miner/participant slowing ETH purchases reduces a form of institutional demand for ether; negative for near-term ETH flow dynamics but limited size relative to total market.

Crypto.title: XRP falls 4% below $1.30 as bitcoin-led market weakness pulls down majors
Crypto.reason: Major altcoin decline driven by BTC-led weakness; symptomatic of broader risk-off in crypto markets rather than an idiosyncratic XRP fundamental, reinforcing the negative market mood.
